holderPosition.legalForm: Share of a registered US money-market fund (Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund), recorded in a blockchain-integrated shareholder record that the transfer agent controls
holderPosition.says: The holder owns fund shares recorded by Franklin Templeton Investor Services, LLC as transfer agent, not any particular Treasury security. The transfer agent can correct errors or unauthorized transactions in the record, so a token balance is not bearer title; redemption is by request on business days and may be delayed or suspended.

chainFacts.says: Token-2022 mint, 9 decimals, supply 409,952.078556536 on Solana.

The mint's own address, 5Tu84fKBpe9vfXeotjvfvWdWbAjy3hqsExvuHgFqFxA1, is mint authority, freeze authority, permanent delegate, transfer-hook authority and metadata authority. The transfer hook runs program huk3EPrNreTdUUjVKVkGSGKF1WC4P9BiUKBkn2kFWnP. Who holds the key is not in the sources.
The older catalogue recorded 110,460.74 on the Solana BENJI leg on 16 September 2026.

outside.says: Requests through the app or portal on business days; payment normally by USD ACH or wire within seven days, with exceptions; the prospectus permits delays and suspension. Minimums depend on the account.

The transfer agent may correct errors or unauthorized transactions, and moves between chains burn and reissue shares. Stays in the prospectus; the chain shows the permanent delegate and freeze authority that can carry out corrections.
Recovery priorities and how a blockchain outage would be resolved were not established.

verdict.summary: This is the clearest fund structure in the batch: a public prospectus names the transfer agent, the custodian and the record that counts. v3 can outline it, but the mint is Token-2022 and cannot be read; ownership-interest hides that the holder has a registered share; the record that prevails, the eligibility rules and the NAV basis can only be proposals. The fund publishes most of its own side, while the custodian, the transfer agent and the auditor say nothing in their own name.
